# All Alcohol and Chem Plan Checklist

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_fa409d9e450f4a1dabf9873f89246da9~mv2.jpg)

The easiest locations to obtain these plans are listed below. Many of these plans can also be acquired through player vendors, events, and daily quests.

To access and purchase plans from MODUS, you must have started the base Enclave questline and gained access to the Whitespring Bunker.

To add the quests "Tipsy Taste-Test" and "Wasted on" to your daily quest rotation, you need to have completed the quest "__Wasted on Nukashine__."

Mr. Squeeze is part of __Random Object Encounters__.

__Project Paradise__ is a Public Event.

**Your progress will be automatically saved as you mark the boxes on the checklist below.**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37a8ee666027440d97d4c2ae0b5393e1~mv2.png)

I'm an Aussie data miner who creates guides for farming, events, and food buffs in Fallout 76.

I firmly believe that knowledge should be accessible to everyone, so my guides will always be free. However, maintaining a website and using photo and video editing software can be costly.

- __Follow Me on Social Media:__ Keep up with my latest updates by following me on social media.

- __One-Time Donation:__ Buy me a coffee.

- __Monthly Contribution:__ Become a regular supporter by subscribing to my Ko-fi page.

Every bit of support helps cover the costs of creating these guides and maybe even gets me a cup of coffee or three;)
